title: Synthetic text benchmark: public evidence status

corpus.title: OpenCOI original synthetic page-text benchmark v1

methodology.protocol: Supply vendor-neutral prediction-v1 artifacts generated from the identical frozen page-text corpus, validate them strictly, then score every supplied artifact with the same deterministic scorer. Do not inspect truth while producing new comparator predictions.
limitations: TESTED records a supplied normalized artifact and publisher declarations; it does not independently verify legal authorization or publication rights.
NOT_TESTED means no authorized publishable artifact was supplied; it is not a zero score and has no delta.
Synthetic zero-touch text parsing does not measure browser OCR, policy status, workflow quality, integrations, usability, or overall product superiority.
The six-case corpus is original synthetic regression data and is too small for a general accuracy claim.
The published OpenCOI baseline was not blinded; it is included only to demonstrate the public protocol and evidence status.
